title: An ending leaves dependable foundations

captions.physics: Distinguishing observation from an exhausted image
captions.energy: Ending an explanation without actual foundations

meaning: Ending an unsupported image can give your shared view dependable footing while preserving observations’ actual content.
text: Dependability can appear after a familiar image ends. Death in the energy position of Ajna supports ending an explanation that has lost its foundation. The Moon in the physical position helps distinguish observation from an exhausted picture. The Emperor in emotions feels supported by clear boundaries. Your view can become steadier through an understandable limit while retaining what is actually known, without immediately needing to restore a complete account of the subject.

Suppose you examine a saved drawing of an old object. You long thought it showed the internal mechanism, but now notice only external parts are depicted. **Ending an unsupported version leaves room for dependable foundations.** An imagined interior no longer serves as explanation. Visible dimensions and the arrangement of parts retain value. Your shared view gains a clear boundary between appearance and unknown mechanism. Calm belongs to that accuracy rather than an obligation to reconstruct immediately a full picture of how the object worked.

The risk is declaring the whole drawing invalid for the sake of renewed dependability. Available observation disappears alongside an exhausted image. Ending the earlier explanation helps name precisely what has finished. The version about a depicted mechanism has gone; external relationships remain visible. Understanding preserves footing when an ending concerns particular foundations and requires neither wholesale dismissal nor immediate replacement by another equally complete answer.
